lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in a grid-like pattern; anterior regions show high-density clusters of small-diameter spots, transitioning to larger, more regularly spaced circular nodes along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of spots align with horizontal rows to create a grid-like arrangement, though distinct vertical bands of elevated intensity are primarily indicated by spot placement rather than continuous vertical lines.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper visible flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-dark gradient from top to bottom.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits an extremely high spatial density of small, high-luminance spots which are significantly smaller and more numerous per unit area than the spots on the main lateral body.
